Moreover, Saadat is mentioned in the context of the Day of Judgment, where the Prophet (peace be upon him) will intercede for his followers, granting them Saadat, or happiness, in paradise.

The pursuit of Saadat is considered a noble goal, as it reflects the genuine desire for happiness, peace, and contentment in life. This search for Saadat is not solely focused on material possessions but on the inner peace and joy that comes from a strong connection with Allah and adherence to Islamic teachings. In this sense, the name Saadat reminds us of the importance of focusing on our spiritual well-being, as it is this inner peace and happiness that ultimately leads to true contentment.
